rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site cohort; nine sites across Europe.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "MRI scans were performed in nine different sites across Europe."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort drawn from Aggressotype and MATRICS projects (in-house consortia); no listed EPDs reported.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Participants in the current study were part of the EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS projects."

rci3_epd_name.detail: No EPDs used for normative model reference cohort.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Participants in the current study were part of the EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS projects."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; reference cohort includes both TD controls and DBD cases (whole cohort used as reference).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "A model of brain development as a function of age and sex was created by training a Gaussian process regression (GPR) model... on a sample of n = 129 and n = 127 (77 cases, Table 1, online Supplementary Fig. S3 for an age distribution) to predict brain function and structure, respectively... Here, we used the whole cohort (both TD and DBD) as a reference"
rci5_n.location: Holz2023.pdf.md: Method / Constructing normative models of brain structure and function

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; model-1 sex counts aggregated from control and case male counts in Table 1 (female_n inferred as total N minus male_n). Model-2 sex breakdown not reported for the n=127 structural sample.

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; model-1 weighted mean and pooled SD computed from control and case age statistics in Table 1; age range from study description (years). Model-2 age statistics not reported for the n=127 structural sample.
rci7_age.location: Holz2023.pdf.md: Abstract / Methods; Holz2023.pdf.md: Table 1. Sample characteristics
